ma.onAppHide(function callback)

Listen for events of switching a Mini Program to the backend. The callback time of this event is the same as that of App.onHide.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for switching a Mini Program to the backend.

Sample Code

let _this; 
let test1 = function () {
    console.log('aaa')
    _this.setData({
        detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'onAppHide:ok',
    })
};

Page({
    onAppHide () {
        _this.setData({
            detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'onAppHide',
        })
        ma.onAppHide(test1)
    }
})
